title: LogSession
description: One saved workout, as stored in ol-sessions and in the GitHub log.json envelope. This is the only user-authored data that really matters when moving to a new UI.

id.description: 's' + epoch milliseconds when created in this app. Must be globally unique and stable across edits.

rev.description: Last write time in epoch ms. The sync merge picks the higher rev. Bump on every edit, including history edits.

ts.description: Creation time in epoch ms. Preserved on edit. Secondary sort key after date.

date.description: Workout date in local time. Never derive from a UTC timestamp.

program.description: Catalog program id (gym, home, minimal, fullbody) or a stale id after the catalog changes.

programLabel.description: Denormalised display label, so history survives catalog edits.

session.description: Session id inside the program (lift-a, lift-b, lift-c, full, or a custom id).

sessionLabel.description: Denormalised display label. Progress entries use 'Progress entry'.

source.description: Present only when the session was created from a manual progress entry; such sessions do not count toward the weekly lift status.

exercises.description: Only exercises with at least one filled set are stored.

note.description: Free text. May be missing in older documents.

id.description: Catalog exercise id, or 'x' + base36 timestamp + 3 random base36 chars for a custom exercise.

name.description: Snapshot of the exercise title at save time. Renames do not rewrite history.

unit.description: 'min' is a cardio duration: one set with reps = minutes and kg = null.

reps.description: Reps, seconds when unit is 'sec', or minutes when unit is 'min'.

Set.description: null means 'not entered'. An empty row is never saved, so at least one field is a number.
